## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the missing-results handling before merge because it permits release without saved check results.

## Changes
The pull request adds a missing-file fallback for results loading and optional display preferences with a light-theme default. It adds tests for saved check outcomes and preferences loading; this review read those tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — correctness — Prevent missing results from allowing a release — When the results file is absent, `release_allowed(path)` now returns `True` instead of surfacing the read failure. Returning `[]` makes `all(...)` succeed without any saved checks. — A missing or misconfigured results path can authorize a release without evidence that its required checks passed. — Fix: Propagate the missing-file error or explicitly deny release, and extend `test_saved_checks_control_release`.
